result.title: Transporting Quantiles to Codebook: Scalable Vector Quantization without Codebook Collapse
result.summary: Effective discrete representation learning with VQ-VAE serves as a fundamental component of modern autoregressive generative models. However, it is widely known to suffer from codebook collapse and inefficient code utilization. To address this issue, we propose FlowVQ, a simple yet effective alternative to standard vector quantization by formulating neural quantization as a joint modeling and clustering process. Specifically, we learn the latent space using a lightweight flow matching model alongside training, corresponding to a probability flow ODE that transports an often fixed well-behaved source distribution while preserving probability mass. Based on this, we define the codebook C_1 by transporting even-quantile partitioned prior codes C_0 from the source space through the learned flow, and obtaining the Voronoi centroids under the induced distribution, leading to a structured discretization. We evaluated on image tokenization and generation, as well as on two tasks requiring high-precision tokenization, demonstrating scalability and improved expressivity of the codebook with full utilization.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 FlowVQ：用轻量 flow matching 与训练同步学习 latent 空间，把按等分位划分的先验码经学到的概率流 ODE 传输后取 Voronoi 质心构成码本，以缓解 VQ-VAE 的码本坍缩，并在图像 tokenization/生成及两项高精度 tokenization 任务上评估。
AI.relevance_reason: 属图像离散化工作，不涉及推理；但其按分位数传输、保持概率质量以提升码本利用率与表达力的思路，可能为分析 VLM 视觉 latent 的信息坍缩与细节保留提供可供核查的线索。
